- Set the opening slightly wider than the handle, with the fingers closing across its width. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides rather than pressing only on top.
- Adjust the hammer orientation in an open area above the table. Near the block, use a small downward tap to reduce the risk of hitting nearby objects with a large swing.
